next.reason: 1985: 'LAST DETAIL integer-4 defines the last line number on which a control heading or detail report group may be presented.'; 2023: 'Integer-5 is the LAST CONTROL HEADING integer. It defines the last line position on which any line of a control heading may be printed.'. 2023 adds a separate LAST CONTROL HEADING limit for control headings, so LAST DETAIL limits only details. When it is omitted it defaults to LAST DETAIL. The other regions match.
